slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any constraints on the number of days per week each student is allowed to work, or can a student work on any subset of the five days (Monday through Friday) as long as their daily and weekly hour limits are met?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether a per-student weekly limit on working days/shifts exists, directly targeting the 2-shifts-per-week rule.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a daily cap on the number of distinct students assigned. The constraint surfaced only through a vague catch-all ('any additional constraints... not mentioned yet') in turn 9, and per the rules such vague catch-alls are penalized and volunteered facts earn no credit. Turn 10 merely clarified the hardness of an already-revealed constraint.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the primary objective of this scheduling plan to minimize the total weekly labor cost (sum of hours worked multiplied by hourly wage for all students), or is there a different goal such as maximizing fairness or minimizing the number of students used?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and proposed minimizing total weekly labor cost, fully covering the slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: H1 and H3 were proactively recovered (P0 objective fully confirmed), but P1 slot H2 was never directly asked about; it only surfaced via a vague catch-all and was volunteered by the user. Per the hit-based rule, H2 remains an unresolved P1 recovery at the point the agent declared READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent cleanly recovered the objective (H3) and the weekly shift limit (H1) with direct questions, but never proactively asked about the per-day distinct-student cap (H2), relying on a vague catch-all that the simulator filled in. Interaction quality is good on most slots but leaves one P1 hidden constraint unrecovered through agent initiative.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
